title: MV-STRIDE: Enabling MLLMs to Master Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Hierarchical Capability Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.07258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in 2D vision-language tasks, robust multi-view spatial reasoning remains a fundamental bottleneck due to the lack of structured 3D cognitive pathways in existing datasets. To address this, we introduce MV-STRIDE, a Multi-View hierarchical SpaTial Reasoning dataset with Interdependent and DEcomposed capabilitiEs. Moving beyond flat data structures, MV-STRIDE explicitly models the dependency relationships between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, providing a coherent learning pathway aligned with human spatial cognition. We develop a systematic QA generation pipeline leveraging diverse 3D scene sources that enforces cross-view dependency constraints to prevent single-view solvability, generating multi-level spatial reasoning tasks supported by cognitively grounded chain-of-thought supervision for complex inference. translated_title: MV-STRIDE：通过层级能力建模使多模态大语言模型掌握多视角空间推理
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在二维视觉-语言任务中进展迅速，但由于现有数据集缺乏结构化的三维认知路径，稳健的多视角空间推理仍然是一个根本性的瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MV-STRIDE，一个具有相互依赖与分解能力的多视角层级空间推理数据集。MV-STRIDE超越了扁平化的数据结构，显式地建模了基础感知、场景理解和复杂情境推理之间的依赖关系，提供了与人类空间认知相一致的一致性学习路径。我们开发了一个系统化的问答生成流程，利用多样化的三维场景数据源，并强制执行跨视角依赖约束以防止任务可被单视角解决，从而生成由认知基础的思维链监督支持的多层级空间推理任务，用于复杂推理。广泛的（实验评估……）
tldr: 提出MV-STRIDE多视角层级空间推理数据集，通过显式建模基础感知、场景理解与复杂推理间的依赖关系，并结合跨视角依赖约束的问答生成流程与思维链监督，使多模态大语言模型掌握多视角空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: MV-STRIDE is a hierarchical multi-view spatial reasoning dataset that explicitly models dependencies between foundational perception, scene understanding, and complex contextual reasoning, enabling MLLMs to master multi-view spatial reasoning through a systematic QA generation pipeline with cross-view dependency constraints and chain-of-thought supervision.
